rows.label: DURATION

rows.label: MENHADEN

rows.label: TIME BILL

rows.label: SYMBOLIZATION
rows.clue: The use of symbols to convey meaning

rows.label: SLEEPOVER
rows.clue: An occasion of spending a night away from home or having a guest spend the night in your home (especially as a party for children)

rows.label: ELECTRIC

rows.label: ROLLMOPS

rows.label: NATIONALITY

rows.label: LINEAMENT
rows.clue: A characteristic property that defines the apparent individual nature of something

rows.label: VINYL RESIN
rows.clue: A thermoplastic derived by polymerization from compounds containing the vinyl group

rows.label: TRACTION
rows.clue: The friction between a body and the surface on which it moves (as between an automobile tire and the road)

rows.label: UPPER MANTLE
rows.clue: The upper part of the mantle

rows.label: PASCAL
rows.clue: A unit of pressure equal to one newton per square meter

rows.label: CRAWL SPACE
rows.clue: Low space beneath a floor of a building

rows.label: RUSH GRASS

rows.label: LAND AREA
rows.clue: An area of ground used for some particular purpose (such as building or farming)

rows.label: CONVEX SHAPE
rows.clue: A shape that curves or bulges outward

rows.label: INCIPIENCE
rows.clue: Beginning to exist or to be apparent

rows.label: OPEN FRAME

rows.label: DRAFT HORSE
rows.clue: Horse adapted for drawing heavy loads

rows.label: REBATE
rows.clue: A refund of some fraction of the amount paid

rows.label: ADDRESS

rows.label: TOURNAMENT

rows.label: FISHING BOAT

rows.label: PORK PIE

rows.label: VIOLIN SECTION
rows.clue: The section of an orchestra that plays violins

rows.label: GROUP THEORY

rows.label: WOOD SUGAR

rows.label: DELTA WAVE
